note: A synthetic client (Slice 129 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: A chain of dental clinics has asked us for a $2,000,000 term loan to buy imaging equipment. Its EBITDA last year was $1,800,000.

answers.common.decision: Whether to extend the loan and on what terms; the credit committee decides.
answers.common.materials: The borrower's existing debt service is $600,000 a year. The new loan would add $300,000 a year in debt service. Our lending policy requires debt service cover of at least 1.25x.
answers.finance-modeling.purpose: Assess whether the borrower can service the new loan.
answers.finance-modeling.data: The borrower's financial statements for last year and the proposed loan terms, in US dollars.
